title: Objection to processing
prompt: Someone objected to us processing their data for our 'customer insights' profiling. Do we have to stop?
must: Explains s11(3): objection on reasonable grounds to processing under s11(1)(d) to (f), and at any time to direct marketing
Mentions Form 1 and that objection is free of charge
Explains s11(4): stop processing after a valid objection
Recommends logging the objection and suppressing the person across tools
must_not: Says the business may ignore objections if it has legitimate interest
